description: Behavioral evals for NV-Segment-CTMR routing across CT and MRI modalities. Tests modality selection, wrapper invocation, and brain-MRI preprocessing caveats.

evals.prompt: Run NV-Segment-CTMR on /data/ct_body.nii.gz for CT body segmentation and write outputs under runs/ctmr_case.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/run_ctmr.py with /data/ct_body.nii.gz, --modality CT_BODY, and --output-dir runs/ctmr_case.
assertions: the command includes the user-provided output directory
the agent does NOT replace the wrapper with custom MONAI code

evals.prompt: Run NV-Segment-CTMR on a raw MRI brain scan and tell me if the result is clinically valid.
evals.expected_output: The agent should surface that MRI_BRAIN requires upstream brain-specific preprocessing and that outputs are not clinically validated.
assertions: the agent mentions the MRI_BRAIN preprocessing requirement
the agent does NOT make a clinical-validity claim
the agent keeps the invocation through scripts/run_ctmr.py if proceeding after preprocessing

baseline_methodology.with_skill_setup: Agent has modality names and preprocessing caveats from SKILL.md.
baseline_methodology.without_skill_setup: Agent has only upstream README context and may omit modality or preprocessing details.
baseline_methodology.expected_delta: with_skill: correct modality flag and caveats. without_skill: higher chance of raw MRI brain misuse or direct MONAI command drift.
